key.name: enable-extension
key.description: Whether to enable the entire UNIM extension

key.name: show-notification
key.description: Whether to show a notification when text is converted

key.name: show-panel-indicator
key.description: Whether to show the Korean/English status indicator in the panel

key.name: enable-ime
key.description: Enable real-time Korean input method (replaces IBus). When enabled, the extension intercepts key events and provides native Korean input via Clutter.InputMethod.

key.name: korean-layout
key.description: The Korean keyboard layout: '2bul' (Dubeolsik), '3bul390' (Sebeolsik 390), '3bul391' (Sebeolsik Final), '3bul_noshift' (Sebeolsik No-Shift)

key.name: initial-mode
key.description: The initial input mode when the session starts: 'Korean' or 'English'

key.name: mode-sharing
key.description: How input mode is shared across apps: 'global' (all apps share), 'per_app' (each app independent)

key.name: popup-mode
key.description: Popup display mode: 'Standalone' (GUI integrated) or 'Embedded' (frontend embedded)

key.name: shortcut-normal
key.description: Convert English to Korean and paste

key.name: shortcut-normal-reverse
key.description: Convert Korean to English and paste
